Sasha V: Quick check — onboarding 7B-openchat into staging. Two problems I hit: model.json points to gs://redwood-models/openchat/7b/v1/weights.tar but the onboard pipeline pulled from s3://redwood-artifacts/models/openchat/7b/weights.tar (so hashes mismatch). Also tokenizer is mapping a sentinel token to the same id as EOS (50256) which makes chat templates emit a token that we treat as terminal. Anyone else run into sentinel==eos collisions?

Anita: I moved the staging weights to S3 and updated model.json in the bundle so the pipeline can pick it up. I left the GCS copy too. Pushed a small manifest change to the bucket. ping @Oliver for config validation — I didn't change tokenizer mappings yet.

Oliver: Looking now. The model bundle's tokenizer.json currently has:
```json
{"eos_token":"","bos_token":"<|bos|>","special_tokens_map":{"sentinel":""},"add_prefix_space":false}
```
That empty sentinel mapping is the culprit — when we convert to our token ids we default to EOS. For chat templates we expect a sentinel like `<|sentinel|>` and for streaming/fallback logic sentinel must not equal eos. Quick proposed config snippet to patch the tokenizer.json:
```json
{"eos_token":"","bos_token":"<|bos|>","sentinel_token":"<|sentinel|>","add_prefix_space":false}
```
and set tokenizer.add_special_tokens = true during bundling.

Carl: FYI if sentinel id == eos id the serving runtime prunes KV cache when it sees that id and we get premature termination. Saw this in continuous-inference tests (ct-testing). If we don't fix tokenizer mapping, chat sessions drop mid-turn.

model-onboard-bot: model validator: FAILED — tokenizer.special_tokens overlap with eos_token for model openchat-7b v1. See run: /ops/onboard/2034567890, error_code: TOKENIZER_COLLISION.

Sasha V: OK — what's the least risky path? Change tokenizer bundle and bump model version, or tweak chat templates to avoid sentinel until we can re-bundle? We prefer not to change templates in customer-facing code.

Anita: Least risky: re-bundle tokenizer with explicit sentinel_token and bump model version (v1 -> v1.1). I'll do that and upload new bundle to S3. Also will add a migration script that remaps sentinel if a downstream serving config sees the collision.

Oliver: SGTM. Also propose adding a config validation rule to the onboarder: reject tokenizer bundles where any special token id equals eos_token id. That would have caught this earlier. I can open a PR for the validator.

Carl: I'll add a unit + integration test for the streaming layer to assert EOS handling when sentinel appears mid-sequence. Will include a small golden prompt that used to fail in ct-testing. ETA: EOD.

Sasha V: @Carl please also include a test that simulates a cached prefix (KV cache reuse) to ensure we don't leak state when sentinel appears. I'll review the PRs. :thumbsup:

Anita: Filed the tokenizer re-bundle PR and pushed new model bundle to s3: https://s3.aws/redwood-artifacts/models/openchat/7b/v1.1/ — updated model.json in the bundle, bumped sha256. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4123 (includes tokenizer.json patch and bundling script change).

Oliver: I started the validator PR (https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4124) — adds a check that special token ids don't collide with eos/bos and rejects ambiguous empty mappings. Also added a short error message for ops.

model-onboard-bot: deploy check: new bundle v1.1 passed validation. onboarding pipeline will schedule a staging deploy.

Sasha V: Nice. Carl — once you have tests + fallback in, let's run a quick canary against staging and watch streaming latency + termination behavior. I will review PRs after lunch.

Carl: Will do. Quick heads-up: I found one small place in the runtime where we compare token id to 50256 (hardcoded). I'm replacing that with runtime.eos_id from tokenizer metadata to avoid future hardcodes.

Anita: Also added a small note to the onboarding runbook: if you change special tokens, include a mapping table in model.json and increment model_version. Saves us these collisions.

Sasha V: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: @Anita confirm weight checksum/manifest dedupe, @Oliver merge validator, @Carl merge tests + runtime eos_id change. I'll do reviews.

Anita: Confirmed weight checksum now matches between S3/GCS copies. I added dedupe logic to the storage uploader to avoid old copies sticking around.

Oliver: Validator PR merged.

Carl: Tests + runtime change in PR 4126, running CI now.

Sasha V: Closing loop after CI passes. Thanks all — nice quick async coordination.
